slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: “求求你了，师姐，我这身体实在吃不消，你就放我一马吧。”
“啊！不要！”
一道惨叫的声音响起，在一个密室之中。
一个美若天仙的女子心满意足地穿上了衣服，居高临下地看着地上的陈默。
冷冷地看着他说道。
“陈默，我劝你最近一定要加快练功，早日多修炼一些真元。”
“到时候，好让师姐我将你修炼所得的真元，以双修秘法吸收。”
“若你偷懒，敢不照做的话，下一次可没这么痛快，到时我便杀你。”
林凤瑶话音刚刚落下，便推开门，走出了这密室之中。
呼吸着外面的新鲜空气，感觉整个人都精神了不少，体内的实力，也获得了一些微弱的提升。
“陈默这个废物，实力虽然低微，不过皮囊倒是不错。”
“但宗门大典在即，如果接下来，他的修炼速度跟不上去，没办法让我吸收更多的真元。”
“到那时，就别怪我这个师姐心狠手辣，将他杀掉，寻找新的道侣练功双修了。”
“到那时，他这个废物留着也没用了。”
话音落下，林凤瑶便离开了此处。
密室之中的陈默，也是一脸的郁闷表情。
从三个月前，他刚刚穿越到这个玄幻世界，就发现自己成了青云宗的外门弟子。
这青云宗，看起来是一个正道宗门，但实际上里面各种歪门邪道为数不少。
就拿刚刚的林凤瑶来说。
便是自己的师姐。
这三个月的时间以来，每次陈默好不容易修炼出一些真元，就会被师姐夺走。
而且还是以双修的方式。
这女人分明把自己当成她的鼎炉。
实在是欺人太甚。
陈默看着地上的狼藉，以及自己现在这副狼狈的样子。
整个人也是恨得不行。
没想到到头来，竟然被一个女人这般羞辱。
而且刚刚林凤瑶还放话。
如果接下来一段时间，自己修炼的真元太少。
没有办法让人家突破实力。
那么自己便没有继续活下去的必要了。
对方就会更换道侣，而把自己给除掉。
到那时，自己才是真正的死翘翘。
想到这里的陈默，瞬间寒毛直竖，也感受到极大的危机意识。
也就是说，自己要是想活下去的话。
在接下来一段时间，必须想尽一切办法变强。
可问题是，就算自己好不容易变强，真元又会被那女人全部吸收掉。
content_en:
"Please, senior sister, my body can't bear it anymore, just let me go."
"Ah! No!"
…
A scream sounded in a secret room.
A woman as beautiful as a fairy put on her clothes with satisfaction and looked down at Chen Mo on the ground.
He looked at him coldly and said.
"Chen Mo, I advise you to speed up your practice recently and cultivate more true energy as soon as possible."
"When the time comes, senior sister and I can absorb the true essence gained from your cultivation with the secret method of dual cultivation."
"If you are lazy and dare not follow my instructions, you won't be so happy next time. I will kill you then."
As soon as Lin Fengyao finished speaking, she opened the door and walked out of the secret room.
Breathing the fresh air outside, I feel that my whole body has become more energetic, and my body's strength has also been slightly improved.
"Chen Mo is a loser. Although his strength is low, his skin is pretty good."
"But the sect's grand ceremony is coming soon. If he can't keep up with his cultivation speed next time, he won't be able to let me absorb more true energy."
"At that time, don't blame me, my senior sister, for being so ruthless as to kill him and find a new Taoist partner to practice dual cultivation."
"By then, there will be no use keeping this good-for-nothing like him."
After the words fell, Lin Fengyao left here.
Chen Mo in the secret room also had a depressed expression on his face.
Three months ago, he had just traveled to this fantasy world and found that he had become an outer disciple of Qingyun Sect.
This Qingyun Sect seems to be a righteous sect, but in fact there are many crooked sects and evil ways inside.
Take Lin Fengyao just now.
She is her senior sister.
In the past three months, every time Chen Mo managed to cultivate some true energy, his senior sister would take it away.
And it’s still in the form of dual cultivation.
This woman clearly regards herself as her cauldron.
It's really too much of a lie.
Chen Mo looked at the mess on the ground and his current embarrassed appearance.
The whole person was filled with hatred.
I didn't expect that in the end, I would be so humiliated by a woman.
Moreover, Lin Fengyao just said something.
If in the next period of time, you have too little real energy to cultivate.
There is no way for people to break through their strength.
Then there is no need for him to continue living.
The other party will change Taoist companions and get rid of themselves.
Until then, he will be truly dead.
Thinking of this, Chen Mo's hair stood on end and he felt a great sense of crisis.
In other words, if you want to live.
In the next period of time, we must do everything we can to become stronger.
But the problem is that even if he finally becomes stronger, all his true energy will be absorbed by that woman.
